# AI Coach Directory

> AI Coach Directory is operated by KCB Integrative LLC and provides purpose-built AI coaching experiences designed around specific user goals.

AI Coaching for Fitness is the current live coaching experience. It provides personalized AI fitness guidance, workout planning, accountability, and progress support.

Available coaching areas include Fitness and Budgeting; Life and Career coaching experiences are planned.

Use the canonical www domain for AI Coach Directory: https://www.aicoachdir.com

Authentication, subscription, and member-login pages are transactional pages and are not intended to be primary indexable content.

AI-generated coaching is informational and motivational. It is not medical care or a substitute for qualified professional advice.

## Key pages

- [AI Coach Directory](https://www.aicoachdir.com/): Primary website and current AI Coaching for Fitness offering.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.aicoachdir.com/terms): Terms governing AI Coach Directory services, subscriptions, AI-generated content, data practices, and user responsibilities.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.aicoachdir.com/sitemap.xml): Search-engine sitemap for intentionally indexable pages.
